DVC.description: Data elements for Digital Vaccination Certificate.

name.description: Name of the recipient of vaccine or prophylaxis

id.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

items.description: Coding-shaped {system, code} object from ValueSet iso3166-1-3

system.description: Establishes the namespace for the value - that is, an absolute URL that describes a set values that are unique.

code.description: A symbol in syntax defined by the system. The symbol may be a predefined code or an expression in a syntax defined by the coding system (e.g. post-coordination).

display.description: A representation of the meaning of the code in the system, following the rules of the system.

userSelected.description: Indicates that this coding was chosen by a user directly - e.g. off a pick list of available items (codes or displays).

type.description: A coded type for the identifier that can be used to determine which identifier to use for a specific purpose.

period.description: Time period during which identifier is/was valid for use.

guardian.description: Name of the parent or guardian. Required where applicable, as defined by the State Party (example: when the recipient is a minor or dependent)
